text:
Let them close my eyes with grapes.

(Transparent, deep fullness of curves.)


Let a blaze of apples wrap me.


Let them wrap me -omen of pulp-

in plums of perfumed touch...


Flood me

in a high tide of petals and trills.


Let them gird me -gird me!- with blue ecliptics.

translation.title: Let Them Close My Eyes with Grapes...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's ritual abundance of fruit, touch, petals, birdsong, and celestial curves.
